description: This file defines the 'entity_reference' field type in Drupal, including the EntityReferenceItem class with methods for schema, settings, constraints, and entity referencing logic.

classes.name: EntityReferenceItem
classes.description: Defines the 'entity_reference' field type in Drupal, handling entity referencing logic, schema, settings, constraints, and sample data generation.

methods.name: defaultStorageSettings
methods.description: Returns default storage settings, targeting 'node' if the 'node' module exists, otherwise 'user'.

methods.name: defaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Returns default field settings with handler 'default' and empty handler settings.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines property schema for the entity reference field, including 'target_id' and 'entity' properties.

methods.name: storageSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of storage settings, including reference type.

methods.name: fieldSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of field settings, including target bundles.

methods.name: mainPropertyName
methods.description: Returns the main property name, 'target_id'.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Defines the database schema for the field, including columns and indexes.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints, removing 'AllowedValuesConstraint'.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the field, supporting entity objects and target IDs, ensuring synchronization.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the field value, including unsaved entities.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Keeps 'target_id' and 'entity' properties in sync when one changes.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the reference is empty based on 'target_id' and 'entity'.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Prepares the entity reference for saving, saving new entities if needed.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates sample reference data for testing, avoiding recursion.

methods.name: getRandomBundle
methods.description: Selects a random bundle for an entity type based on selection settings.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for editing storage settings.

methods.name: fieldSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for editing field settings, including reference handler options.

methods.name: fieldSettingsFormValidate
methods.description: Validates the field settings form, invoking the reference handler validation.

methods.name: hasNewEntity
methods.description: Determines if the reference holds an unsaved entity.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies for the field, including default values and target bundles.

methods.name: calculateStorageDependencies
methods.description: Calculates storage dependencies, including the target entity type provider.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Updates dependencies when related configurations are removed.

methods.name: getPossibleValues
methods.description: Returns possible reference values for the field.

methods.name: getPossibleOptions
methods.description: Returns reference options for the field.

methods.name: getSettableValues
methods.description: Returns settable reference values.

methods.name: getSettableOptions
methods.description: Returns reference options grouped by bundle labels.

methods.name: fieldSettingsAjaxProcess
methods.description: Processes AJAX updates for field settings form.

methods.name: fieldSettingsAjaxProcessElement
methods.description: Recursively adds AJAX behavior to form elements.

methods.name: formProcessMergeParent
methods.description: Adjusts form element parents for processing.

methods.name: settingsAjaxSubmit
methods.description: Handles AJAX form submission for settings.

methods.name: getPreconfiguredOptions
methods.description: Provides preconfigured reference options for common entity types.

methods.name: getReferenceableBundles
methods.description: Returns referenceable bundles for the target entity type.
